topics.title: Citizenship
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Islamabad ke park mein agar koi litter phenke, to aap kya karenge? Chhote se kaam se shehar clean reh sakta hai!

## SAMJHAO
Citizen woh shakhs hai jo kisi mulk ka hissa ho. Global citizen duniya ke logon ka khayal rakhta hai. Digital citizen internet par bhi tameez aur safety rakhta hai.

Rights (huqooq) jaise taleem aur khayal-rakhna — aur responsibilities (zimmedariyan) jaise qanoon manna, dusron ka ehtram, aur gandagi na phenkna.

Civic sense: line mein khade hona, zor se shor na karna, aur madad karna.

## MISAAL
School bus mein seat dena, traffic light wait karna, aur WhatsApp pe jhooti khabar forward na karna — yeh sab achhe citizen ke kaam hain.

## KARO
Ghar mein 3 rights aur 3 responsibilities ki list banao. Ek digital safety rule likho.

## SAWAAL
1. Citizen ka matlab kya hai?
2. Ek responsibility ka misaal do.
3. Digital citizen kya karta hai?

topics.title: Culture
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Punjabi, Pashto, Sindhi, Balochi, Urdu — itni zubanein ek mulk mein! Yeh diversity Pakistan ki khubsurati hai.

## SAMJHAO
Culture = logon ke tarike: zabaan, khana, libaas, festivals, aur riwayat. Nation = log jo ek mulk se judte hain.

Pakistan mein kai ethnic groups aur mazahib mil kar rehte hain. Interfaith harmony matlab ek dusre ka ehtram.

Communication (baat-cheet): bolna, likhna, phone, TV — fayde aur nuqsan dono hain.

## MISAAL
Eid, Christmas, Diwali — dost mil kar khushi manate hain. Islamabad ke Melas mein alag dresses dikhte hain.

## KARO
Apne ghar ka ek festival aur ek favourite dish likho. Ek dost ki culture se ek nayi baat poochho.

## SAWAAL
1. Culture mein kya shamil hota hai?
2. Diversity ka fayda kya hai?
3. Interfaith harmony kya hai?

topics.title: State aur Government
topics.description: State vs government, elections, good leader
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
School ka principal badal sakta hai, lekin school ki building aur rules rehte hain — thoda aisa hi state aur government ka farq hai!

## SAMJHAO
State = mulk (zameen, log, qanoon). Government = woh log / nizam jo mulk chalate hain (thori der ke liye chuney jate hain).

Constitution = bunyadi qanoon ki kitab. General Elections = log vote dekar leaders chunte hain.

Achha leader: sachcha, madadgar, sunne wala, aur sab ke liye insaaf.

## MISAAL
Class monitor chunna — vote, phir zimmedari. Wahi chhoti si election ki practice.

## KARO
3 qualities of a good leader likho. Ghar walon se poochho: vote kya hota hai?

## SAWAAL
1. State aur government mein farq?
2. Constitution kya hai?
3. Achhe leader ki ek quality?

topics.title: History
topics.description: Early people, Indus Valley, old stories of land
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Pakistan ki zameen bohot purani hai — yahan Indus Valley jaisi qadeem civilization thi!

## SAMJHAO
History = guzray waqt ki kahani (sources: books, ruins, coins, stories).

Ancient civilizations: Indus Valley (Harappa, Mohenjo-daro) — planned streets, wells, seals. Mehrgarh jaisi purani bastiyan bhi is ilaqe se judti hain.

Hum seekhte hain ke log kaise rehte they, kya banate they, aur kyun tabdeeli aayi.

## MISAAL
Museum mein purani mitti ke bartan dekhna — woh bhi history ka source hai.

## KARO
Ek timeline banao: pehle → phir → aaj. Indus Valley ki 2 baatein yaad karo (streets, wells).

## SAWAAL
1. History kya hai?
2. Indus Valley ki ek khas baat?
3. History ka ek source?

topics.title: Geography
topics.description: Maps, directions, Pakistan land and climate basics
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Bina map ke nayi gali mein kho jana asaan hai — map humein rasta dikhata hai!

## SAMJHAO
Map essentials (BOLTS): Border, Orientation (north), Legend, Title, Scale.

Directions: North South East West. Globe zameen ka model hai.

Pakistan: mountains, plains, desert, coast — alag ilaqe. Weather short-term; climate long-term pattern. Population = kitne log rehte hain.

## MISAAL
Islamabad se Murree — map par north/east check karo. School map par class rooms dhundo.

## KARO
Apne kamre ka chhota map banao (door, window, table). North mark karo.

## SAWAAL
1. BOLTS mein L kis liye?
2. Scale kis kaam aata hai?
3. Climate aur weather mein farq?

topics.title: Economics
topics.description: Goods, services, money, needs vs wants, banks
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Roti zaroori hai — naya toy aksar want hota hai. Needs aur wants ka farq samajhna smart money ka pehla qadam!

## SAMJHAO
Goods = cheezein (kitab, fruit). Services = madad / kaam (doctor, teacher, barber).

Money se asani se exchange hota hai. Bank paisa mehfuz rakhta hai aur kabhi savings help karta hai.

Resources limited hoti hain — is liye choose karna parta hai (scarcity). Trade = dena-lena.

## MISAAL
Kachay bazaron se sabzi (goods); doctor check-up (service). Pocket money save karna bank / gilty piggy bank se shuru.

## KARO
5 needs aur 5 wants likho. Ek goods aur ek service ki misaal do.

## SAWAAL
1. Goods aur services mein farq?
2. Bank ka ek kaam?
3. Need ki misaal?
